items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: we formed this band called Lawrence Murad and I. It was the original Diamond Band. And we had Bush Hall on the trumpet.

ctx.x: I know a lot of people bought those and they wouldn't even have a part for them in late years anymore.

Yeah, late years they cut it. They changed the orchestration. Orchestration used to be put up for shell and oboe and all that stuff as time went to change. But anyway, we formed this band called Lawrence Murad and I. It was the original Diamond Band. And we had Bush Hall on the trumpet. That's the time I'd taken a wife. We weren't making much money. And then I went with Kid René's band. That was up until 1922. And I went with Kid René's band. I wanted to get me, especially Simon Murad was in the band. So I quit…

items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: On the trumpet we had Bush Hall.

ctx.x: Now we formed a band ourselves.

And I don't want to make it too long but I'll tell you some of the members of the band. On drumming we had Si Frasier, Josiah Frasier on drumming. On bass we had Eddie Barrera. On piano we had Mercedes Fields. On the trumpet we had Bush Hall. Well Bush Hall died and he was replaced with Red Alam. He had Red Alam. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera. Darius…

items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: He helped me and Lawrence and the rest of the show to play the music.

ctx.x: Yeah, Lawrence Morera and Joe Saia. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Who was Bush? Bush was a trumpet player. He was a fine trumpet player. He came up under Buddy P.T. Buddy P.T. was his instructor. He was the only one in the band who could read music. He helped me and Lawrence and the rest of the show to play the music. So I in turn helped Ray Allen. Yeah.
What was Bush's name? Bush Hall.
